title: FeeTaker is incompatible with fee-on-transfer tokens
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  When a fee-on-transfer token is used as a taker asset, the `FeeTaker.sol` contract receives `takingAmount - tokenFee`.
